summary: Frontend-only investor persona gateway regression executed on public preview URL. Most route/content/responsive requirements pass, but customer department/industry progression is blocked by sticky launch bar intercepting clicks.

ui_bugs.issue: Department buttons (and therefore downstream industry step) are not selectable via normal pointer in desktop flow because the sticky launch bar overlays the button hit area.

integration_issues.issue: URL persistence for department/industry fails under real pointer interaction since department click is intercepted; only DOM-programmatic click updates params.

issues: Sticky launch rail overlaps taxonomy grid hit targets during selection, reducing accessibility and blocking intended progression.

action_items: Fix z-index/pointer-event overlap so customer department buttons remain clickable while sticky launch bar is visible.
Retest full role->department->industry progression using real pointer clicks at desktop/tablet/mobile.
Re-verify reduced-motion flow with this fix to ensure no interaction regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerSelector uses a sticky launch footer (z-index:20) that can sit above taxonomy items and intercept pointer events; this is the root cause of progression failures.
Investor/customer destination routes and architecture tabs are structurally isolated under /investor and do not impact global / and /demo routes.
Required department and industry inventories exist with unique data-testid naming patterns and expected spellings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated passing areas: /investor gateway loads, investor intent query works, venture/strategic/operator routes distinct, architecture five-tab panel switching works, autoplay pauses on manual tab select, required taxonomy lists and spellings present, direct-load customer role+department+industry routes render correct contextual labels, / and /demo remain healthy, and no horizontal overflow at 1920x800 / 768x1024 / 390x844. Blocking defect is pointer interception from sticky launch bar over department grid (confirmed via elementFromPoint and DOM-click control).
rca of the issue: Repro: open /investor/customer -> select role (e.g., Technical) -> attempt click on department (e.g., Engineering). Observed URL remains ?role=technical, industry stays disabled. Diagnostic: elementFromPoint at department button center returns customer-selector-launch, proving overlay interception. DOM programmatic click on same button immediately updates URL with department and marks selection, confirming business logic works but pointer path is blocked. Mitigation: adjust sticky launch placement/z-index/pointer-events or reserve bottom spacing during taxonomy interaction.
